goal: Implement and verify the first assigned-report Developer MVP slice.
decisions: Reuse the existing Supabase lifecycle schema and enforce a second author/status gate for note edits.
Use server-side Supabase access with an explicit profile-role check and assignment filter.
Do not add AI or code execution to this baseline slice.
findings: The existing migration had no note updated_at or author/status update policy; the follow-up migration adds both.
The workflow checker cannot run on Windows because workflow/scripts/agent_workflow.py imports fcntl.
acceptance_criteria: T001-T014 are implemented or have recorded verification evidence.
No user-controlled role, assignment, status, or revision mutation is introduced by the dashboard.
verification: npm test, npm run typecheck, and npm run lint are blocked because dependencies could not be installed in the environment
